verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַתָּ֨ה עֹבֵ֤ר הַיּוֹם֙ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָבֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת גּוֹיִ֔ם גְּדֹלִ֥ים וַעֲצֻמִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑ךָּ עָרִ֛ים גְּדֹלֹ֥ת וּבְצֻרֹ֖ת בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ yiś·rā·’êl ’at·tāh ‘ō·ḇêr hay·yō·wm ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên lā·ḇō lā·re·šeṯ gō·w·yim gə·ḏō·lîm wa·‘ă·ṣu·mîm mim·me·kā ‘ā·rîm gə·ḏō·lōṯ ū·ḇə·ṣu·rōṯ baš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Hear O Israel Today you are about to cross the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you with large cities fortified to the heavens
verses.literalPt: OUVE, ó Israel, hoje passarás o Jordão, para entrares a possuir nações maiores e mais fortes do que tu; cidades grandes, e muradas até aos céus;

verses.original: עַֽם־ גָּד֥וֹל וָרָ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י עֲנָקִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ וְאַתָּ֣ה שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ מִ֣י יִתְיַצֵּ֔ב לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am- gā·ḏō·wl wā·rām bə·nê ‘ă·nā·qîm ’ă·šer ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā wə·’at·tāh šā·ma‘·tā mî yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ lip̄·nê bə·nê ‘ă·nāq
verses.literal: The people are strong and tall the descendants of the Anakim You know about them and you have heard it said Who can stand up to the sons of Anak
verses.literalPt: Um povo grande e alto, filhos de gigantes, que tu conheces, e de que já ouviste. Quem resistiria diante dos filhos dos gigantes?

verses.original: וְיָדַעְתָּ֣ הַיּ֗וֹם כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ הֽוּא־ הָעֹבֵ֤ר לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵ֣שׁ אֹֽכְלָ֔ה ה֧וּא יַשְׁמִידֵ֛ם וְה֥וּא יַכְנִיעֵ֖ם לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְהֽוֹרַשְׁתָּ֤ם וְהַֽאַבַדְתָּם֙ מַהֵ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā hay·yō·wm kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā hū- hā·‘ō·ḇêr lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ’êš ’ō·ḵə·lāh hū yaš·mî·ḏêm wə·hū yaḵ·nî·‘êm lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·hō·w·raš·tām wə·ha·ʾa·ḇaḏ·tå̄m ma·hêr ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh lāḵ
verses.literal: But understand that today the LORD your God goes across ahead of you as a consuming . . . fire He will destroy them . . . and subdue them before you And you will drive them out and annihilate them swiftly as the LORD has promised you
verses.literalPt: Sabe, pois, hoje que o SENHOR teu Deus, que passa adiante de ti, é um fogo consumidor, que os destruirá, e os derrubará de diante de ti; e tu os lançarás fora, e cedo os desfarás, como o SENHOR te tem falado.

verses.original: אַל־ תֹּאמַ֣ר בִּלְבָבְךָ֗ בַּהֲדֹ֣ף יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ אֹתָ֥ם׀ מִלְּפָנֶיךָ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ בְּצִדְקָתִי֙ הֱבִיאַ֣נִי יְהוָ֔ה לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את וּבְרִשְׁעַת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֔לֶּה יְהוָ֖ה מוֹרִישָׁ֥ם מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·mar bil·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ba·hă·ḏōp̄ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ō·ṯām mil·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā lê·mōr bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯî hĕ·ḇî·’a·nî Yah·weh lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ ū·ḇə·riš·‘aṯ hag·gō·w·yim hā·’êl·leh Yah·weh mō·w·rî·šām mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: When the LORD your God has driven them out before you . . . do not say in your heart Because of my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land Rather, the LORD is driving out these nations before you because of their wickedness
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, o SENHOR teu Deus os lançar fora de diante de ti, não fales no teu coração, dizendo: Por causa da minha justiça é que o SENHOR me trouxe a esta terra para a possuir; porque pela impiedade destas nações é que o SENHOR as lança fora de diante de ti.

verses.original: לֹ֣א בְצִדְקָתְךָ֗ וּבְיֹ֙שֶׁר֙ לְבָ֣בְךָ֔ אַתָּ֥ה בָ֖א לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־ אַרְצָ֑ם כִּ֞י בְּרִשְׁעַ֣ת׀ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֗לֶּה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ מוֹרִישָׁ֣ם מִפָּנֶ֔יךָ וּלְמַ֜עַן הָקִ֣ים אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָה֙ לַאֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lō ḇə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā ū·ḇə·yō·šer lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ’at·tāh ḇā lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣām kî bə·riš·‘aṯ hag·gō·w·yim hā·’êl·leh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mō·w·rî·šām mip·pā·ne·ḵā ū·lə·ma·‘an hā·qîm ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh la·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: It is not because of your righteousness or uprightness of heart that you are going in to possess their land but it is because of their wickedness that the LORD your God is driving out these nations before you to keep the promise He swore to your fathers to Abraham Isaac and Jacob
verses.literalPt: Não é por causa da tua justiça, nem pela retidão do teu coração que entras a possuir a sua terra, mas pela impiedade destas nações o SENHOR teu Deus as lança fora, de diante de ti, e para confirmar a palavra que o SENHOR jurou a teus pais, Abraão, Isaque e Jacó.

verses.original: וְיָדַעְתָּ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֤א בְצִדְקָֽתְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֠לֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵ֨ן לְךָ֜ אֶת־ הָאָ֧רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֛ה הַזֹּ֖את לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ כִּ֥י עַם־ קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֖רֶף אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî lō ḇə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh haz·zōṯ lə·riš·tāh kî ‘am- qə·šêh- ‘ō·rep̄ ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: Understand, then that it is not because of your righteousness that the LORD your God is giving you this good land to possess for you are a stiff-necked . . . people
verses.literalPt: Sabe, pois, que não é por causa da tua justiça que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá esta boa terra para possuí-la, pois tu és povo obstinado.

verses.original: זְכֹר֙ אַל־ תִּשְׁכַּ֔ח אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־ הִקְצַ֛פְתָּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְמִן־ הַיּ֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יָצָ֣אתָ׀ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם עַד־ בֹּֽאֲכֶם֙ עַד־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה מַמְרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם עִם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr ’al- tiš·kaḥ ’êṯ ’ă·šer- hiq·ṣap̄·tā ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bam·miḏ·bār lə·min- hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer- yā·ṣā·ṯā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ‘aḏ- bō·’ă·ḵem ‘aḏ- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh mam·rîm hĕ·yî·ṯem ‘im- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Remember this and never forget how you provoked the LORD your God in the wilderness From the day you left the land of Egypt until you reached . . . this place you have been rebelling against the LORD
verses.literalPt: Lembra-te, e não te esqueças, de que muito provocaste à ira ao SENHOR teu Deus no deserto; desde o dia em que saístes do Egito, até que chegastes a esse lugar, rebeldes fostes contra o SENHOR;

verses.original: וּבְחֹרֵ֥ב הִקְצַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתְאַנַּ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה בָּכֶ֖ם לְהַשְׁמִ֥יד אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḥō·rêḇ hiq·ṣap̄·tem ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·yiṯ·’an·nap̄ Yah·weh bā·ḵem lə·haš·mîḏ ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: At Horeb you provoked the LORD and He was angry enough to destroy you
verses.literalPt: Pois em Horebe provocastes à ira o SENHOR, tanto que o SENHOR se indignou contra vós para vos destruir.

verses.original: בַּעֲלֹתִ֣י הָהָ֗רָה לָקַ֜חַת לוּחֹ֤ת הָֽאֲבָנִים֙ לוּחֹ֣ת הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁר־ כָּרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּכֶ֑ם וָאֵשֵׁ֣ב בָּהָ֗ר אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔לְתִּי וּמַ֖יִם לֹ֥א שָׁתִֽיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ă·lō·ṯî hā·hā·rāh lā·qa·ḥaṯ lū·ḥōṯ hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm lū·ḥōṯ hab·bə·rîṯ ’ă·šer- kā·raṯ Yah·weh ‘im·mā·ḵem wā·’ê·šêḇ bā·hār ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm wə·’ar·bā·‘îm lay·lāh le·ḥem lō ’ā·ḵal·tî ū·ma·yim lō šā·ṯî·ṯî
verses.literal: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone the tablets of the covenant that the LORD made with you I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights I ate no bread and drank no water
verses.literalPt: Subindo eu ao monte a receber as tábuas de pedra, as tábuas da aliança que o SENHOR fizera convosco, então fiquei no monte quarenta dias e quarenta noites; pão não comi, e água não bebi;

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֶת־ שְׁנֵי֙ לוּחֹ֣ת הָֽאֲבָנִ֔ים כְּתֻבִ֖ים בְּאֶצְבַּ֣ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַעֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כְּֽכָל־ הַדְּבָרִ֡ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה עִמָּכֶ֥ם בָּהָ֛ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵ֖שׁ בְּי֥וֹם הַקָּהָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên Yah·weh ’ê·lay ’eṯ- šə·nê lū·ḥōṯ hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm kə·ṯu·ḇîm bə·’eṣ·ba‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm wa·‘ă·lê·hem kə·ḵāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ‘im·mā·ḵem bā·hār mit·tō·wḵ hā·’êš bə·yō·wm haq·qā·hāl
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . gave me the two stone tablets inscribed by the finger of God with the exact words that the LORD spoke to you out of the fire on the mountain on the day of the assembly
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR me deu as duas tábuas de pedra, escritas com o dedo de Deus; e nelas estava escrito conforme a todas aquelas palavras que o SENHOR tinha falado convosco no monte, do meio do fogo, no dia da assembléia.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִקֵּץ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֛י לֻחֹ֥ת הָאֲבָנִ֖ים לֻח֥וֹת הַבְּרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·qêṣ ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm wə·’ar·bā·‘îm lā·yə·lāh nā·ṯan Yah·weh ’ê·lay ’eṯ- šə·nê lu·ḥōṯ hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm lu·ḥō·wṯ hab·bə·rîṯ
verses.literal: And at the end of forty days and forty nights the LORD . . . gave me the two stone tablets the tablets of the covenant
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu, pois, que ao fim dos quarenta dias e quarenta noites, o SENHOR me deu as duas tábuas de pedra, as tábuas da aliança.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י ק֣וּם רֵ֤ד מַהֵר֙ מִזֶּ֔ה כִּ֚י שִׁחֵ֣ת עַמְּךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹצֵ֖אתָ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם סָ֣רוּ מַהֵ֗ר מִן־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ם עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם מַסֵּכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay qūm rêḏ ma·hêr miz·zeh kî ši·ḥêṯ ‘am·mə·ḵā ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯā mim·miṣ·rā·yim sā·rū ma·hêr min- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯim ‘ā·śū lā·hem mas·sê·ḵāh
verses.literal: And the LORD said to me Get up and go down from here at once for your people whom you brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them They have made for themselves a molten image
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR me disse: Levanta-te, desce depressa daqui, porque o teu povo, que tiraste do Egito, já se tem corrompido; cedo se desviaram do caminho que eu lhes tinha ordenado; fizeram para si uma imagem de fundição.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֣י לֵאמֹ֑ר רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה עַם־ קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֖רֶף הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh wə·hin·nêh ‘am- qə·šêh- ‘ō·rep̄ hū
verses.literal: The LORD also said to me . . . I have seen this people and they are indeed a stiff-necked . . . people
verses.literalPt: Falou-me ainda o SENHOR, dizendo: Atentei para este povo, e eis que ele é povo obstinado;

verses.original: הֶ֤רֶף מִמֶּ֙נִּי֙ וְאַשְׁמִידֵ֔ם וְאֶמְחֶ֣ה אֶת־ שְׁמָ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ אֽוֹתְךָ֔ לְגוֹי־ עָצ֥וּם וָרָ֖ב מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: he·rep̄ mim·men·nî wə·’aš·mî·ḏêm wə·’em·ḥeh ’eṯ- šə·mām mit·ta·ḥaṯ haš·šā·mā·yim wə·’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’ō·wṯ·ḵā lə·ḡō·w- ‘ā·ṣūm wā·rāḇ mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Leave Me alone so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven Then I will make you into a nation mightier and greater than they are
verses.literalPt: Deixa-me que os destrua, e apague o seu nome de debaixo dos céus; e te faça a ti nação mais poderosa e mais numerosa do que esta.

verses.original: וָאֵ֗פֶן וָֽאֵרֵד֙ מִן־ הָהָ֔ר וְהָהָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֑שׁ וּשְׁנֵי֙ לֻחֹ֣ת הַבְּרִ֔ית עַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֥י יָדָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·p̄en wā·’ê·rêḏ min- hā·hār wə·hā·hār bō·‘êr bā·’êš ū·šə·nê lu·ḥōṯ hab·bə·rîṯ ‘al šə·tê yā·ḏāy
verses.literal: So I went back down . . . the mountain while it was blazing with fire with the two tablets of the covenant in . . . my hands
verses.literalPt: Então virei-me, e desci do monte; o qual ardia em fogo e as duas tábuas da aliança estavam em ambas as minhas mãos.

verses.original: וָאֵ֗רֶא וְהִנֵּ֤ה חֲטָאתֶם֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָכֶ֔ם עֵ֖גֶל מַסֵּכָ֑ה סַרְתֶּ֣ם מַהֵ֔ר מִן־ הַדֶּ֕רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·re wə·hin·nêh ḥă·ṭā·ṯem Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ‘ă·śî·ṯem lā·ḵem ‘ê·ḡel mas·sê·ḵāh sar·tem ma·hêr min- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: And I saw how you had sinned against the LORD your God you had made for yourselves a molten calf You had turned aside quickly from the way that the LORD had commanded you
verses.literalPt: E olhei, e eis que havíeis pecado contra o SENHOR vosso Deus; vós tínheis feito um bezerro de fundição; cedo vos desviastes do caminho que o SENHOR vos ordenara.

verses.original: וָאֶתְפֹּשׂ֙ בִּשְׁנֵ֣י הַלֻּחֹ֔ת וָֽאַשְׁלִכֵ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדָ֑י וָאֲשַׁבְּרֵ֖ם לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eṯ·pōś biš·nê hal·lu·ḥōṯ wā·’aš·li·ḵêm mê·‘al šə·tê yā·ḏāy wā·’ă·šab·bə·rêm lə·‘ê·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of . . . my hands shattering them before your eyes
verses.literalPt: Então peguei das duas tábuas, e as arrojei das minhas mãos, e as quebrei diante dos vossos olhos.

verses.original: וָֽאֶתְנַפַּל֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה כָּרִאשֹׁנָ֗ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔לְתִּי וּמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א שָׁתִ֑יתִי עַ֤ל כָּל־ חַטַּאתְכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲטָאתֶ֔ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eṯ·nap·pal lip̄·nê Yah·weh kā·ri·šō·nāh ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm wə·’ar·bā·‘îm lay·lāh le·ḥem lō ’ā·ḵal·tî ū·ma·yim lō šā·ṯî·ṯî ‘al kāl- ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ·ḵem ’ă·šer ḥă·ṭā·ṯem la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lə·haḵ·‘î·sōw
verses.literal: Then I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights as I had done the first time I did not eat bread or drink water . . . because of all the sin you had committed in doing what was evil in the sight of the LORD and provoking Him to anger
verses.literalPt: E me lancei perante o SENHOR, como antes, quarenta dias, e quarenta noites; não comi pão e não bebi água, por causa de todo o vosso pecado que havíeis cometido, fazendo mal aos olhos do SENHOR, para o provocar à ira.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יָגֹ֗רְתִּי מִפְּנֵ֤י הָאַף֙ וְהַ֣חֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָצַ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם לְהַשְׁמִ֣יד אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י גַּ֖ם בַּפַּ֥עַם הַהִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: kî yā·ḡō·rə·tî mip·pə·nê hā·’ap̄ wə·ha·ḥê·māh ’ă·šer qā·ṣap̄ Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem lə·haš·mîḏ ’eṯ·ḵem way·yiš·ma‘ Yah·weh ’ê·lay gam bap·pa·‘am ha·hi·w
verses.literal: For I was afraid . . . of the anger and wrath that the LORD had directed against you enough to destroy you But the LORD listened to me this time as well
verses.literalPt: Porque temi por causa da ira e do furor, com que o SENHOR tanto estava irado contra vós para vos destruir; porém ainda por esta vez o SENHOR me ouviu.

verses.original: וּֽבְאַהֲרֹ֗ן הִתְאַנַּ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה מְאֹ֖ד לְהַשְׁמִיד֑וֹ וָֽאֶתְפַּלֵּ֛ל גַּם־ בְּעַ֥ד אַהֲרֹ֖ן בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽוא
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·’a·hă·rōn hiṯ·’an·nap̄ Yah·weh mə·’ōḏ lə·haš·mî·ḏōw wā·’eṯ·pal·lêl gam- bə·‘aḏ ’a·hă·rōn bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w
verses.literal: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him but at that time I also prayed for Aaron
verses.literalPt: Também o SENHOR se irou muito contra Arão para o destruir; mas também orei por Arão ao mesmo tempo.

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ חַטַּאתְכֶ֞ם אֲשֶׁר־ עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם אֶת־ הָעֵ֗גֶל לָקַחְתִּי֮ וָאֶשְׂרֹ֣ף אֹת֣וֹ׀ בָּאֵשׁ֒ וָאֶכֹּ֨ת אֹת֤וֹ טָחוֹן֙ הֵיטֵ֔ב עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־ דַּ֖ק לְעָפָ֑ר וָֽאַשְׁלִךְ֙ אֶת־ עֲפָר֔וֹ אֶל־ הַנַּ֖חַל הַיֹּרֵ֥ד מִן־ הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ·ḵem ’ă·šer- ‘ă·śî·ṯem ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḡel lā·qaḥ·tî wā·’eś·rōp̄ ’ō·ṯōw bā·’êš wā·’ek·kōṯ ’ō·ṯōw ṭā·ḥō·wn hê·ṭêḇ ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- daq lə·‘ā·p̄ār wā·’aš·liḵ ’eṯ- ‘ă·p̄ā·rōw ’el- han·na·ḥal hay·yō·rêḏ min- hā·hār
verses.literal: And I took that sinful thing the calf you had made and burned it in the fire Then I crushed it and ground it to powder as fine as dust and I cast it into the stream that came down from the mountain
verses.literalPt: Porém eu tomei o vosso pecado, o bezerro que tínheis feito, e o queimei a fogo, e o pisei, moendo-o bem, até que se desfez em pó; e o seu pó lancei no ribeiro que descia do monte.

verses.original: וּבְתַבְעֵרָה֙ וּבְמַסָּ֔ה וּבְקִבְרֹ֖ת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה מַקְצִפִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ṯaḇ·‘ê·rāh ū·ḇə·mas·sāh ū·ḇə·qiḇ·rōṯ hat·ta·’ă·wāh maq·ṣi·p̄îm hĕ·yî·ṯem ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: You continued to provoke . . . the LORD at Taberah at Massah and at Kibroth-hattaavah
verses.literalPt: Também em Taberá, e em Massá, e em Quibrote-Hataavá provocastes muito a ira do SENHOR.

verses.original: וּבִשְׁלֹ֨חַ יְהוָ֜ה אֶתְכֶ֗ם מִקָּדֵ֤שׁ בַּרְנֵ֙עַ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר עֲלוּ֙ וּרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָכֶ֑ם וַתַּמְר֗וּ אֶת־ פִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֤א הֶֽאֱמַנְתֶּם֙ ל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם בְּקֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇiš·lō·aḥ Yah·weh ’eṯ·ḵem miq·qā·ḏêš bar·nê·a‘ lê·mōr ‘ă·lū ū·rə·šū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem wat·tam·rū ’eṯ- pî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·lō he·’ĕ·man·tem lōw wə·lō šə·ma‘·tem bə·qō·lōw
verses.literal: And when the LORD sent you out . . . from Kadesh-barnea He said Go up and possess the land that I have given you But you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God You neither believed Him nor obeyed Him
verses.literalPt: Quando também o SENHOR vos enviou de Cades-Barnéia, dizendo: Subi, e possuí a terra, que vos tenho dado: rebeldes fostes ao mandado do SENHOR vosso Deus, e não o crestes, e não obedecestes à sua voz.

verses.original: מַמְרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם עִם־ יְהוָ֑ה מִיּ֖וֹם דַּעְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mam·rîm hĕ·yî·ṯem ‘im- Yah·weh mî·yō·wm da‘·tî ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: You have been rebelling against the LORD since the day I came to know you
verses.literalPt: Rebeldes fostes contra o SENHOR desde o dia em que vos conheci.

verses.original: וָֽאֶתְנַפַּ֞ל לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים הַיּ֛וֹם וְאֶת־ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים הַלַּ֖יְלָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְנַפָּ֑לְתִּי כִּֽי־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לְהַשְׁמִ֥יד אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eṯ·nap·pal lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’êṯ ’ar·bā·‘îm hay·yō·wm wə·’eṯ- ’ar·bā·‘îm hal·lay·lāh ’ă·šer hiṯ·nap·pā·lə·tî kî- ’ā·mar Yah·weh lə·haš·mîḏ ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: So I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights - because the LORD had said He would destroy you
verses.literalPt: E prostrei-me perante o SENHOR; aqueles quarenta dias e quarenta noites estive prostrado, porquanto o SENHOR dissera que vos queria destruir.

verses.original: וָאֶתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֶל־ יְהוָה֮ וָאֹמַר֒ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אַל־ תַּשְׁחֵ֤ת עַמְּךָ֙ וְנַחֲלָ֣תְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּדִ֖יתָ בְּגָדְלֶ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹצֵ֥אתָ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם בְּיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eṯ·pal·lêl ’el- Yah·weh wā·’ō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’al- taš·ḥêṯ ‘am·mə·ḵā wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer pā·ḏî·ṯā bə·ḡā·ḏə·le·ḵā ’ă·šer- hō·w·ṣê·ṯā mim·miṣ·ra·yim bə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh
verses.literal: And I prayed to the LORD and said O Lord GOD do not destroy Your people Your inheritance whom You redeemed through Your greatness and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand
verses.literalPt: E orei ao SENHOR, dizendo: Senhor DEUS, não destruas o teu povo e a tua herança, que resgataste com a tua grandeza, que tiraste do Egito com mão forte.

verses.original: זְכֹר֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב אַל־ תֵּ֗פֶן אֶל־ קְשִׁי֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאֶל־ רִשְׁע֖וֹ וְאֶל־ חַטָּאתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’al- tê·p̄en ’el- qə·šî hā·‘ām haz·zeh wə·’el- riš·‘ōw wə·’el- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Remember Your servants Abraham Isaac and Jacob Overlook . . . . . . the stubbornness of this . . . people and the wickedness . . . of their sin
verses.literalPt: Lembra-te dos teus servos, Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó. Não atentes para a dureza deste povo, nem para a sua impiedade, nem para o seu pecado;

verses.original: פֶּן־ יֹאמְר֗וּ הָאָרֶץ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצֵאתָ֣נוּ מִשָּׁם֒ מִבְּלִי֙ יְכֹ֣לֶת יְהוָ֔ה לַהֲבִיאָ֕ם אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּמִשִּׂנְאָת֣וֹ אוֹתָ֔ם הוֹצִיאָ֖ם לַהֲמִתָ֥ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: pen- yō·mə·rū hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯā·nū miš·šām mib·bə·lî yə·ḵō·leṯ Yah·weh la·hă·ḇî·’ām ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- dib·ber lā·hem ū·miś·śin·’ā·ṯōw ’ō·w·ṯām hō·w·ṣî·’ām la·hă·mi·ṯām bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Otherwise those in the land from which You brought us out . . . will say Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land He had promised them and because He hated them He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Para que o povo da terra donde nos tiraste não diga: Porquanto o SENHOR não os pôde introduzir na terra de que lhes tinha falado, e porque os odiava, os tirou para matá-los no deserto;

verses.original: וְהֵ֥ם עַמְּךָ֖ וְנַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵ֙אתָ֙ בְּכֹחֲךָ֣ הַגָּדֹ֔ל וּבִֽזְרֹעֲךָ֖ הַנְּטוּיָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm ‘am·mə·ḵā wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯe·ḵā ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯā bə·ḵō·ḥă·ḵā hag·gā·ḏōl ū·ḇiz·rō·‘ă·ḵā han·nə·ṭū·yāh
verses.literal: But they are Your people Your inheritance whom You brought out by Your great power and outstretched arm
verses.literalPt: Todavia são eles o teu povo e a tua herança, que tiraste com a tua grande força e com o teu braço estendido.
